description:
ExpertPdf HTML to PDF Converter is a .NET library that converts web pages, HTML strings and HTML files to PDF documents and images. It renders the HTML like a browser, with a choice of rendering engines, and gives you full control over the PDF: page settings, headers and footers, bookmarks, links, security, PDF/A, tagged PDF and electronic invoices.

This package contains the library for .NET Framework 2.0 to 4.8.1. It is the build for 64-bit (x64) applications; for x86 and AnyCPU applications use ExpertPdfHtmlToPdf.

Features
- Convert web pages (URLs), HTML strings and HTML files to PDF documents, and to images
- Three rendering engines: WebKit (built in), Blink and Chromium (separate engine packages) with full support for HTML5, CSS3, web fonts and modern JavaScript
- Page size, orientation, margins, fit width, page breaks control (CSS page-break, keep together), repeated table headers
- Headers and footers with HTML content and page numbering
- Automatic bookmarks, table of contents, live internal and external links
- Tagged (accessible) PDF / PDF/UA, PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b, PDF/A-3b, PDF/A-3u, PDF/A-3a and PDF/X-1a
- ZUGFeRD 2.x / Factur-X electronic invoices and associated files (PDF/A-3)
- Security: user and owner passwords, print / copy / edit permissions, 40, 128 and 256 bit encryption; digital signatures
- Authentication, cookies, HTTP headers and POST data; select or exclude page elements; JavaScript delay and conversion triggered from JavaScript
- Add text, images, shapes and more HTML to the generated PDF; merge with existing PDF documents
- Thread safe: convert in parallel in web applications and services

Rendering engines
- WebKit - built in, the default engine.
- Chromium (Chromium 154) - install ExpertPdf.HtmlToPdf.Chromium.Windows.x64; Windows; runs in its own process.
releaseNotes: Version 22.0: New Chromium rendering engine (Chromium 154), running out of process: the ExpertPdf.HtmlToPdf.NetCore.Chromium.Windows and ExpertPdf.HtmlToPdf.Chromium.Windows packages; RenderingEngine.Chromium. Blink rendering engine updated to Chromium 148, with more robust launching under load (BlinkEngineLaunchTimeout, BlinkEngineLaunchMaxTries, BlinkMaxThreadPoolWorkers). Tagged (accessible) PDF and PDF/UA-1: PdfConverter.Tagged and Language, PdfTagType, alternate and actual text, artifacts. PDF/A-2b, PDF/A-3b, PDF/A-3u and PDF/A-3a (PdfStandardSubset); associated files (Document.AddAssociatedFile). ZUGFeRD 2.x / Factur-X electronic invoices: Document.AddZugferdInvoice (Minimum to Extended and XRechnung profiles). New options: HttpPostParameters, SecureProtocol, RenderElementSelector, PageRanges, WindowStatus, EnableOfflineMode, WebGlEnabled, AllowContentHeightResize. Bookmarks, internal links and HTML elements mapping on the Blink and Chromium engines. ManagedContentTrimming: with the Chromium engine the last page ends where the content ends. MaxConversionTime: a time limit for one conversion, on every engine. Asynchronous methods with cancellation: GetPdfBytesFromUrlAsync, SavePdfFromUrlToFileAsync and more. Table of contents with page numbers and links (Document.InsertTableOfContents), page labels and named destinations.
summary: HTML to PDF converter for .NET: convert web pages, HTML strings and files to PDF and images with the WebKit, Blink or Chromium rendering engine. 64-bit build.
title: ExpertPdf HTML to PDF Converter for .NET x64
